notes.title: Patch 1.6 available!
notes.content:
It's high time for a new update. It includes a few improvements and some new content.
[list]
 [*]4 new bosses to beat. It also means 4 new achievements to unlock.
[*]Customizable cursors. Now it's possible to choose one from many available.
[*]Leaderboards. Compare your results with other players.
[*]Increased chance to find magic apple, needed to unlock "Orchard Man" achievement. For players who played more than 5 hours (without finding the apple), a chance to find it will be greatly increased.
[*]A few modifications in items generation system, to make a gameplay even more interesting. 
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.5 now available!
notes.content:
Patch 1.5 has been just released. In this version we've added really a lot of content. Take a look at the list below, to see what's new in the update:
[list]
 [*]new character to unlock - Treant
 [*]5 minibosses
 [*]7 pets to find - bomb, gold chest, fire dragon, flying saucer, goblin pyromancer, scary skull, rock golem. Each of them have some useful skill to help you fight with monsters.
 [*]alternative look of 2 locations - Swamps and Desolation
 [*]a few rare and powerful items to get
 [*]many new achievements to unlock
 [*]a lot of new interactive environment elements, to make the game looks even more randomly
[/list]

notes.title: New update - patch 1.3!
notes.content:
We're very happy to announce that next update is now available. Main changes below:
[list]
    [*] [b]Portuguese translation[/b]. Now Razenroth is also available in a portuguese language.
    [*] [b]Improvements in saving system[/b]. Now you can load your saved game as many times as you want, not only once, like before.
    [*] [b]Portals[/b]. After defeating a boss you can return to the level and complete unfinished tasks, replenish your life, or collect missing items etc. Additionally, there is a high chance for a special portal to appear in a boss area. This portal leads to a special room, where you can find or buy some very useful items.
    [*] [b]New alternative look of the Caves[/b].
[/list]

notes.title: New update available (patch 1.3)
notes.content:
We're very happy to announce that next update is now available. Main changes below:

- Portuguese translation. Now Razneroth is also available in a portuguese language.
- Improvements in saving system. Now you can load your saved game as many times as you want, not only once like before
- Portals. After defeating a boss you can return to the level to complete unfinished tasks, to replenish your life, or collect missing items etc. 
There is a high chance for an additional portal to appear in a boss area. This portal leads to a special room, where you can find/buy some useful items.
- New alternative look of the Caves.

notes.title: Patch 1.2 now available!
notes.content:
Hi all! We've just released a new update for Razenroth.
This update features a few important improvements:
[list]
    [*] 8 new talents - customize your character in any way you want. Now you have much more possibilities than before.
    [*] 3 new stats - armor, mana regeneration, speed
    [*] Saves - the game saves your progress automatically, at the beginning of new level. You can load your game progress once per game.
   [*] Enemies out of the range of your sight won't attack you now. It allows to avoid situations when monsters were attacking you, but you couldn't see them.
[/list]
Thanks for your support.

notes.title: First update is now out!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! We would like to announce that Razenroth's first update is now out. Below is a list of changes and improvements:
[list]
    [*]We've add a new alternative look for the first level - Coniferous Forest
    [*]New static objects at Cemetery (level 5)
    [*]More icons on a map, to help players find useful things
    [*]Reset of statistic and talents is now much cheaper, so you can change your build easily
    [*]Now Dark Crystals are cheaper to buy. First bosses drop more of them than previously.
[/list]
